newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt woman accused in knockout death of neighbour.
newsitem.headline: Egypt woman accused in knockout death of neighbour.

text.p: Police in southern Egypt on Thursday arrested a woman accused of killing her neighbour with a punch during a fight over their children, security sources said.

They said Mariam Ahmed Abdelal, 32, was detained after she knocked out Gamalat Mossad Farghali, 23. The fight in Sohag province started when Abdelal told Farghali her children were making too much noise while playing, the sources said.
